candidate_targets: unhelpful and inaccurate beliefs about happiness
original_extraction.evidence_text:
I’m not posing these questions just to grab your attention. This book is based on a growing body of
scientific research that suggests we are all caught in a powerful psychological trap. We lead our
lives ruled by many unhelpful and inaccurate beliefs about happiness—ideas widely accepted by
society because ‘everyone knows they are true’. On the surface, these beliefs seem to make good
sense—that’s why you encounter them again and again in nearly every self-help book you ever
read. But these erroneous beliefs are both the cause of and the fuel for a vicious cycle, in which the
more we try to find happiness, the more we suffer. And this psychological trap is so well hidden, we
don’t even have a clue that we’re caught and controlled by it.

---

The good news is there’s hope. You can learn how to recognise the ‘happiness trap’ and, more
importantly, you can learn how to climb out of it—and stay out. This book will give you all the
skills and knowledge you need to do it. It’s based on a revolutionary new development in human
psychology: a powerful model for change known as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT).
generation_rules: Provide skills and knowledge to recognize and climb out of the happiness trap
original_extraction.psychological_function: Identifying and disrupting a vicious cycle where attempts to find happiness increase suffering
repetition_rules: Highlight the commonality and persistence of erroneous beliefs about happiness
original_extraction.therapeutic_function: Helping individuals recognize and escape the psychological trap of pursuing happiness based on unhelpful and inaccurate beliefs
voice_rules: Use a reassuring and hopeful tone emphasizing scientific research and new psychological models
